fixed_formulas.target_observed_imports: Sum documented (origin!=destination) natal->adult next-year resight IDs across all sources for each recipient
fixed_formulas.observed_resident_natal_nextyear: v1.231 known natal origin same-island next-year resight count for recipient itself
fixed_formulas.observed_immigrant_fraction: imports/(imports + resident next-year resights) when denominator>0
fixed_formulas.donor_richness: Number of source islands with >=1 documented immigrant to recipient
fixed_formulas.hill_simpson: (sum incoming counts)^2/(sum incoming source counts^2), null if no immigrants
fixed_formulas.dominant_donor: Most recorded immigrants to recipient, deterministic numeric donor-ID tie break
fixed_formulas.observed_vs_marked_donor_fraction: dominant observed share divided by dominant natal-marked cohort fraction among all nonrecipient islands; detection/effort confounded
fixed_formulas.recipient_pair_shared_donor_probability: sum_s p(s|recipientA)*p(s|recipientB) for independent draws from observed migrant lists
fixed_formulas.hypothetical_source_deletion: Remove all recorded edges from a given source; count missing recorded immigrants only, NOT any demographic or causal extinction

universe: ALL 11 recipient islands and ALL 11 source islands for EACH historical/bridge/later era; no threshold chosen after outcome or favorable island cherry-pick
claim_boundary: Same published Helgeland bird source also used by Ranke et al 2021 and Hansson Frank 2026; no independent replication
Parentage and actual reproductive contribution from Dryad 2025 remain unavailable due to 401 API and 403 website, no substitution
Recorded natal-resighted immigrant does not imply survival at receiving island, fitness, rescue or island recolonization
Source diversity depends on finite sample and study-specific detection
Same-source recipient overlap means shared DOCUMENTED migrant origin, not documented simultaneous local loss
Annual exposure differs historical 20 years versus later 7 years: no unadjusted temporal claim
No predictive heldout score, causal inference, confidence intervals or p-values
